title: Weak lensing catalogues and cosmology with UNIONS, Euclid and SPT
author: Cail Daley
description: How large weak-lensing analyses are done today, through Euclid × SPT-3G CMB lensing and UNIONS cosmic shear, and where simulation pipelines take them.

sections.title: Opening
sections.outline: How large lensing analyses are done today: a long chain checked against simulations, collaborations the size the data needed, and an opening for small teams with ambitious methods.

sections.title: Euclid × SPT-3G
sections.outline: Euclid shear and clustering crossed with SPT-3G CMB lensing: the overlap, the pipeline and its mocks, the blinded TR1 data vector, the lens ratio as a check on shear calibration, blinded posteriors against ACT DR6, and where SPT-3G is tighter.

sections.title: UNIONS
sections.outline: The first UNIONS cosmic-shear release over 3,500 deg², validated with B-modes and mocks and blinded, and the new 191-million-galaxy catalogue over 5,200 deg² that opens the survey to tomography.

sections.title: Simulations, agents, SBI
sections.outline: Pipeline, simulations and data held against each other; work chosen to scale with compute; one simulation framework with fidelity dialled against speed; agents running the checks; SBI as where it ends; what collaborations are for; Lightcone.

sections.title: Backup
sections.outline: The blinding rehearsal on a mock, the systematics-template crosses and the FLASK covariance; the UNIONS v2 error bars, robustness tests, contours and the IA prior.
